title: Payments Settlement Settings for Order Refunds on Cartwise Gift Cards
content:
Payments settlement holds three settings per Cartwise Gift Cards card type for order refunds: whether a refund of an order the card paid goes back to the card, whether gift cards are refunded before the order's other payment methods, and where the refund goes once the card has expired or closed.

| Card type | Order refund returns to the card | Gift card refunded before other payment methods | Destination when the card has expired or closed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise eGift Card | Yes | Yes | The original card |
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | Yes | Yes | The original card |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | Yes | Yes | The original card |
| Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card | Yes | Yes | Cartwise credit |
| Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | Yes | Yes | The original card |
| Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card | Yes | Yes | The original card |

## Settings defined

- **Order refund returns to the card.** When an order paid by the card is refunded, the refund goes back to that card. The setting is Yes on every card type.
- **Gift card refunded first.** Order refunds return to gift cards before the order's other payment methods. The setting is Yes on every card type.
- **Destination after expiry or closure.** Where the card that paid the order has expired or closed, the refund goes to one of two destinations: the original card, or Cartwise credit. The Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card is the only card type whose setting is Cartwise credit; the other five return to the original card.

## Settlement queries

**A Cartwise Corporate Gift Card that paid an order has since closed. Where does a refund of that order go?**
To the original card, which is that card type's destination setting after expiry or closure.

**A Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card that paid an order has since expired. Where does a refund of that order go?**
To Cartwise credit, which is that card type's destination setting after expiry or closure.
